_comentario: Planos independientes: ninguno depende de otro, así que todos paralelizan y cualquiera se rehace solo. Se montan con cortes.

planos.funcion: ARRANQUE DEL BUCLE. El módulo entero desde la escotilla: las bandejas bajo luz magenta y la Tierra en el ojo de buey.

WIDE SHOT, hand-painted 2D animated film with soft painterly textures, calm, slow and quiet.
MOTION: LOCKED-OFF STATIC CAMERA, perfectly still for the whole shot. The only motion: the Earth in the porthole turns very slowly and its clouds drift, and one or two leaves sway very slightly. Everything else in the picture, including every light, is a still painting: nothing changes in brightness or colour from the first frame to the last.
FRAMING: hold the exact shot size and composition of the first frame.
AUDIO: [Ambient] The only sounds are a soft steady hum of ventilation, a faint electrical hum from the grow lights, and an occasional tiny drip of water.
Everything in the frame stays exactly as it is in the first frame for the whole shot: the same place, the same objects in the same positions, the same time of night, the same light. The frame holds only what the first frame shows, from beginning to end. Animate only the gentle motion described above; the rest of the picture stays still.
